body.purpose: Balanced hero copy with selective bold and muted emphasis.

motion.name: entrance-expressive

components.name: Primary Call to Action
components.description: The main capsule action over the hero atmosphere.
components.html: Explore Homes
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px 0 25px; gap: 15px; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1 'Instrument Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; background: #151717; border: 1px solid #151717; border-radius: 999px; transition: color 220ms ease, background-color 220ms ease, transform 220ms ease; } .ds-cta svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.5; transition: transform 220ms ease; } .ds-cta:hover { color: #151717; background: transparent; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-cta:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151717; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-cta:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Compact Account Action
components.description: A compact authentication action positioned at the header's trailing edge.
components.css: .ds-account { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 94px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; color: #fff; font: 500 15px/1 'Instrument Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; background: #151717; border-radius: 999px; transition: color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-account:hover { color: #151717; background: #fff; } .ds-account:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151717; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-account:active { color: #fff; background: #151717; }

components.name: Editorial Navigation
components.description: A sparse centered navigation row with directional underline feedback.
components.html: SearchAgentsResourcesAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 31px; color: #151717; font: 500 15px/1 'Instrument Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 12px 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 6px; left: 0; height: 1px; content: ''; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 240ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151717; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav a:active { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Hero Statement
components.description: The centered editorial statement with bold, muted, and action hierarchy.
components.html:
Come Home to Haven

Expert agents. Real guidance. A clear path to what comes next.

Explore Homes
components.css: .ds-statement { padding: 56px 24px; color: #151717; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-align: center; background: #fff; } .ds-statement h1 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(4.8rem, 7.3vw, 6.6rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: .93; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-statement p { margin: 22px 0 0; font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.2vw, 2rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-statement p strong { font-weight: 700; } .ds-statement p span { color: rgba(21,23,23,.5); } .ds-statement a { display: inline-flex; margin-top: 31px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 25px; align-items: center; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; background: #151717; border: 1px solid #151717; border-radius: 999px; transition: color 220ms ease, background-color 220ms ease, transform 220ms ease; } .ds-statement a:hover { color: #151717; background: transparent; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-statement a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151717; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-statement a:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: HAVEN Mask Transition
components.description: The signature mark treatment that moves from drawn outline to image-filled silhouette.
components.html: HAVEN
components.css: .ds-haven-mask { position: relative; width: min(67.85vw, 977px); aspect-ratio: 977 / 423; overflow: hidden; -webkit-mask: url('/assets/haven-logo.svg') center / contain no-repeat; mask: url('/assets/haven-logo.svg') center / contain no-repeat; transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity 300ms ease; } .ds-haven-mask img { position: absolute; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ds-haven-sky { inset: 0; } .ds-haven-house { inset: 18% 0 0; object-fit: contain !important; object-position: top center; } .ds-haven-mask span { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); } .ds-haven-mask:hover { transform: scale(1.025); } .ds-haven-mask:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151717; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-haven-mask:active { transform: scale(1); }

narrative.overview:
This world treats a home not as a catalogue item but as atmosphere becoming identity. Pale sky, isolated architecture, drifting cloud, and rising smoke create cinematic scale; the journey culminates when that complete landscape is held inside the exact HAVEN letterforms.

The editorial layer is deliberately restrained: black ink on white, one geometric sans serif, sparse navigation, oversized type, and capsule actions. The interface stays quiet so the scroll choreography can carry the emotion. Every movement preserves spatial continuity and feels like a camera move through one scene, never a collection of unrelated effects.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome editorial controls over a photographic sky and architectural composition.
Oversized, tightly tracked headlines balanced by compact navigation and pill actions.
Full-viewport sticky staging with long, scrubbed transforms and layered parallax.
An exact HAVEN logo silhouette used as both outline and photographic mask.
Smooth reduced-motion and responsive fallbacks that preserve the visual hierarchy.

rules.name: The Monochrome Interface Rule
rules.body: Interactive chrome remains Carbon Ink and Clear Paper; color arrives through the photographic atmosphere, not extra UI accents.

rules.name: The Contrast Is the State Rule
rules.body: Hover states invert or reveal the existing black-and-white relationship instead of introducing decorative color.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from scale, weight, opacity, and spacing; do not add a decorative display face.

rules.name: The Phrase First Rule
rules.body: Preserve complete phrases and balanced wraps before reducing display scale.

rules.name: The One Stage Rule
rules.body: All hero layers share one sticky viewport and one spatial coordinate system so scroll motion reads as a continuous camera move.

rules.name: The Atmospheric Depth Rule
rules.body: Use overlap and transformed image planes for depth; never add card shadows to the hero world.

rules.name: The Exact Mark Rule
rules.body: The outline, mask, and header brand must derive from the same HAVEN vector artwork so every transition lands without silhouette drift.

dos: Do keep the interface monochrome and let the source imagery carry atmospheric color.
Do preserve the exact HAVEN vector across the header, outline drawing, and image mask.
Do animate transforms and opacity on independent layers to maintain smooth spatial continuity.
Do enlarge controls and rebalance fixed scene geometry for mobile rather than merely scaling the desktop composition.
Do make the static reduced-motion state complete, legible, and immediately available.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, colored buttons, glass cards, or shadows that compete with the photographic stage.
Don't substitute a font-rendered word for the HAVEN vector or alter its proportions.
Don't scatter the hero into disconnected animations; every layer should advance one continuous reveal.
Don't hide content behind loading choreography after required assets and fonts are ready.
Don't extend the hero's visual treatment into unrelated landing-page sections without a product reason.
